description:
This is one of the best kept secrets of Boston! Take to the water and experience Boston Harbor at Golden Hour aboard the yacht Patriot. There is no better way to end the day than on a classic yacht at sunset in Boston Harbor.  This sunset cruise is the perfect Boston date night idea offering stunning scenic views and cozy nautical charm. 

Whether you are visiting town or are a native local, a Boston Harbor Cruise will offer a unique way of viewing the Boston skyline.  Enjoy our comfortable lounge seating along with your favorite drink in hand as you cruise past all of the iconic sites this city has to offer. Special bonus: take in the maritime tradition and watch the sun dip beyond the horizon as you experience the USS Constitution cannon fire at sunset in Boston Harbor. 

#Key Points on this Boston Harbor Sunset Cruise:
* This Boston Sunset Cruise is 1.5-hours long.
* Tickets on the Boston sunset boat ride start at $56 per person.
* This sunset cruise is aboard the Yacht Patriot – Patriot is a modern reproduction of a 1920’s commuter yacht.
* The Yacht Patriot is our most intimate boat in the Boston fleet. With comfortable wrap around lounge seating for up to 30 guests. 
* This is not a narrated tour and offers background music to create a relaxing atmosphere along with a special USS Constitution cannon fire at sunset. 
* Cruise Boston Harbor with us and enjoy this unique experience with friends, colleagues or loved ones!
 
#Highlights on this 1.5-hour Constitution Sunset Cruise:    
* See Fort Independence while taking in views of Boston's Seaport District along the way. 
* View the steeple of the Old North Church - made famous by Paul Revere’s Ride.
* Pass by Bunker Hill Monument and grounds of the Battle of Bunker Hill.
* See USS Cassin Young and the USS Constitution with a special Constitution cannon fire display at sunset.
